system.description:
Attitude and tenacity are as core to the gunslinger as ammo. They stare down challenges through iron sights, fortified by their inner grit.


Iconic Gunslingers

• Arthur Morgan, Red Dead Redemption 2

• Django, Django Unchained

• Roland Deschain, Dark Tower


Playing Gunslinger

The gunslinger is a low-defense, high-crit striker. In combat, stay as far back as possible and keep the enemy under constant fire.


Action: Attack

Move: Backline


Training: Ranged, Detect

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: After you make a Ranged attack, you Crit on subsequent Ranged attacks on a d20 roll 1 lower, and can stack up to 3 times. It resets at the end of your Turn if you didn’t hit a Ranged attack since the start of your last Turn.

features.name: Quickdraw
features.description: You gain the Quick Draw Perk and, once per Round, you can make a Ranged attack against an attack that would hit. If you pass, reduce the damage dealt by the Target’s attack by your attack’s damage.

features.name: Bad Medicine
features.description: You deal an extra die of damage when you Crit with a Ranged Check. The number of extra dice increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Grit
features.description:
At the start of your Turn, you can increase your Deadeye by 3 to remove a Status from yourself from either Blinded, Burning, Confused, Dazed, or Frightened.


The increase is reduced by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter (minimum 0).

features.name: Devastator
features.description: When you Crit with a Ranged Check, the damage dice can Explode.

features.name: Grit
features.description:
At the start of your Turn, you can increase your Deadeye by 2 to remove a Status from yourself from either Blinded, Burning, Confused, Dazed, or Frightened.


The increase is reduced by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter (minimum 0)

features.name: High Noon
features.description: When you kill an Enemy, your Deadeye is immediately set to 17.

features.name: Grit
features.description: At the start of your Turn, you can remove a Status from yourself from either Blinded, Burning, Confused, Dazed, or Frightened.
